validationQueries.name: Schema contains tables
validationQueries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tables FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE();

validationQueries.name: API tokens table exists
validationQueries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = 'api_tokens';

validationQueries.name: Admissions schema contains tables
validationQueries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tables FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE();

validationQueries.name: Accounts schema contains tables
validationQueries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tables FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE();

validationQueries.name: All posted vouchers balanced (DR = CR)
validationQueries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unbalanced_count FROM (SELECT voucherNo, SUM(CASE WHEN transactionType='DR' THEN transaction_amount ELSE 0 END) AS dr, SUM(CASE WHEN transactionType='CR' THEN transaction_amount ELSE 0 END) AS cr FROM fin_ledger l JOIN fin_journalnumbers j ON j.JournalNo = l.voucherNo WHERE j.PostStatus='Posted' GROUP BY voucherNo HAVING ABS(dr - cr) > 0.005) t;

validationQueries.name: No zero-amount ledger entries
validationQueries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_amount_count FROM fin_ledger WHERE transaction_amount = 0;

validationQueries.name: Financial periods defined
validationQueries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS period_count FROM fin_financial_years;

validationQueries.name: At least one open financial period
validationQueries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_periods FROM fin_financial_years WHERE status = 'Open';

validationQueries.name: Portal schema contains tables
validationQueries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tables FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE();
